_autoReindex: Watches your library folders and reindexes a presentation moments after you edit it. Set to false to turn it off and reindex by hand from the Health screen. It never starts a full rebuild on its own, and never reindexes more than 25 changed presentations without being asked.
_slideFlagsModule: Where Flag this slide keeps its flags. Leave folder null to keep them on this machine only. Point it at a folder two machines can both see (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive) to share one list; each flag is its own file, so they never overwrite each other. Optional: types replaces the problem-type list (each {"label", "icon"}, icon a Lucide name); keepResolvedDays is how long a resolved flag stays on the Flags screen (default 14, never deleted).
_serviceModule: The Service screen: a timing rundown of what went live in each service, and lock-in for live events. Off until enabled. Everything else is optional. schedule lists recurring services in this machine's local time, e.g. [{"day": "sun", "time": "09:00", "name": "Early", "playlistMatch": "early"}]; playlistMatch picks the playlist whose name contains it. Refrain watches closely from leadMinutes before a start to trailMinutes after. folder works like slideFlagsModule.folder: one file per event, safe in a synced folder. playlistMatch plus today's date picks this week's playlist (6/7/26, 06/07/26, Jun-07-26, Jun 7 and 2026-06-07 are all recognised). summaryFolder, if set, gets a copy of each day summary End writes (a new file every time, never an overwrite). phases replaces the checklist: [{"name": "Arrive", "scope": "day", "steps": ["Screens on", {"label": "Run the checks", "checks": true}]}], where scope is day, service (once per service) or between (after every service but the last), and a step with end: true ticks when the day is ended. Leave it null for the default.
